segments.tts: AI may have just solved a million-dollar math problem – and that's not even this week's biggest story.

On Thursday, mathematician Levent Alpöge presented a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, developed with the AI Claude. A 167-year-old mystery. The proof is written so computers can check every step – and experts are reviewing it now. If it holds, it's historic.

But here's what saves lives: an AI reading a single routine heart ultrasound found 78 percent of patients with hidden heart failure – versus 48 percent without AI. And an AI trained on Swedish patient data spots warning signs of sudden cardiac death that standard tests miss.
Quick hit: Inkling 2 Mini – a free AI that runs offline on a laptop. Smart help, without your data ever leaving your computer.
